---
title: 'spfungorum_records'
description: 'Retrieve Species Fungorum (Index Fungorum) records for a taxon, filtered to Brazil evidence'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::spfungorum_records()
```

### Description

Given a fungal species or genus, retrieves every matching name from
[Species Fungorum](https://www.speciesfungorum.org) (the nomenclatural database
maintained by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, also known as Index Fungorum) and, by
default, filters the result down to only the names whose own reported locality places
them in Brazil - returning a structured spreadsheet of Index Fungorum information
(including each name's original Species Fungorum URL) for those Brazilian records.
Like `mycobank_records`, this is a straightforward retrieval tool,
not a gap/comparison one - it does not cross-check FFB at all.

### Details

Species Fungorum/Index Fungorum has no bulk export, but it does publish a public,
documented web service (https://www.indexfungorum.org/ixfwebservice/fungus.asmx)
that answers plain HTTP GET requests with XML - no SOAP client, headless browser, or
authentication required. A single request returns every name matching `taxon`,
including, for many records, the type specimen's own reported `LOCATION` and
`HOST` fields - the data this function uses as its Brazil-evidence signal. Unlike
MycoBank, no per-record page visit is needed: everything comes back in one response.

Index Fungorum's `LOCATION` field very often names a Brazilian state directly
(e.g. `"Pernambuco"`) rather than the country itself, so
`Fungorum_Brazil_Evidence` checks `Fungorum_Location` against the country
name and every Brazilian state name (with or without diacritics), not just the literal
word "Brazil".

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character. A single fungal species or genus name (e.g. `"Phellinotus neoaridus"` or `"Phellinotus"`). |
| rank | Character. Whether `taxon` is a `"species"` (default) or a `"genus"`. Species Fungorum's web service has no operation for searching by higher classification (order/family), so `rank = "order"` is not supported. |
| require_brazil_evidence | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the returned table is filtered to only the names whose Index Fungorum `Location` mentions Brazil (the country name or any Brazilian state). Set to `FALSE` to instead return every matching name regardless of locality, for manual review. |
| max_number | Numeric. Maximum number of matching names requested from the web service in a single call. Defaults to `1000`, generous for any genus. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the result is saved to disk as an `.xlsx` spreadsheet. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the spreadsheet is saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"spfungorum_records"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the `.xlsx` file (without extension) to save. Defaults to `"spfungorum_records_<taxon>"`. |
| html_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), also writes a self-contained HTML report (`<dir>/<filename>.html`) summarizing the results: KPI counts and the full record table as a sortable, filterable DT widget with buttons to copy or download it as CSV/Excel. Requires the rmarkdown, DT, and htmltools packages; if any is missing, the report is skipped with a message (the `.xlsx` spreadsheet is unaffected). |
| open_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default in interactive sessions), opens the rendered HTML report in the default browser. |

### Value

A `data.frame`, one row per matching Index Fungorum name and, by default,
  with a Brazilian reported locality, with columns:

  Fungorum_NumberIndex Fungorum's numeric record identifier for the name.
  Taxon_nameThe binomial as registered in Index Fungorum.
  AuthorsAuthor citation.
  YearYear of publication.
  Name_statusIndex Fungorum's nomenclatural status (e.g. `"Legitimate"`).
  Current_nameIndex Fungorum's currently accepted name for this entry, when
    different (i.e. when `Taxon_name` is itself a synonym).
  Fungorum_Location, Fungorum_HostType specimen locality and host, as reported
    in Index Fungorum's own record (may be `NA` - not every record has these).
  Fungorum_URLDirect link to the name's Species Fungorum page.
  Fungorum_Brazil_EvidenceLogical; `TRUE` when `Fungorum_Location`
    mentions Brazil (the country or any Brazilian state).

### Examples

```r
# All Index Fungorum information for a single species, only if it reports a
# Brazilian locality
sp <- spfungorum_records(taxon = "Phellinotus neoaridus")

# Every Index Fungorum species-level name in genus Phellinotus with a
# Brazilian reported locality
genus_records <- spfungorum_records(taxon = "Phellinotus", rank = "genus")

# Every matching name regardless of locality, for manual review
all_records <- spfungorum_records(taxon = "Phellinotus", rank = "genus",
                                      require_brazil_evidence = FALSE)
```
